title: Robert Booth and Julia Kollewe's 'OpenAI Boss and Elon Musk Back Calls to Put Brakes on Reckless AI Development'. A Warning Is Not a Brake.
short_version: Four frontier AI bosses endorsed slowing down, inside a weekend, and none gave up anything: the evaluators are ones each company invites and can decline to renew. The only person naming a force that isn't goodwill, product-liability exposure, was arguing against it.
